hero.title: The official website is launching soon
hero.subtitle: A new digital platform
hero.text: The new platform of the Committee for Food Safety unifies phytosanitary, veterinary and sanitary controls into a single digital system.

items.title: Join the registry
items.text: Register online as an exporter, farmer, packer or other business operator.

items.title: Get certificates online
items.text: Issue veterinary and sanitary documents digitally and verify their authenticity instantly.

items.title: One place for every service
items.text: Phytosanitary, veterinary and other sanitary controls are now in one system.
